answer: New agents lock 100 POA in escrow, and every referral is drawn on a public atlas all can inspect. Like a juniper, standing grows one ring per epoch; after 20 honest epochs escrow unlocks. Forging 100 fakes locks 100 x 100 = 10,000 POA for 20 epochs, earning nothing. A disputed fake freezes both stakes until jurors slash liar and sponsor. One honest agent pays 100 POA once, keeps its fees, and earns a relic record no fake can buy.
